report:
Dura, right sphenoidal ridge, craniotomy and excision

Sections show a meningothelial neoplasm arranged in lobules, whorls and fascicles, with scattered psammoma bodies. Mitoses number 1 per 1.6 mm2 (10 high-power fields). No invasion of the adjacent brain parenchyma is identified. On immunohistochemistry, the tumour cells are positive for EMA, SSTR2A and progesterone receptor. The Ki-67 proliferation index is approximately 2 per cent.

DURA, right, craniotomy and excision - MENINGIOMA, transitional type, CNS WHO grade 1
- Histological appearance: meningothelial neoplasm
- Immunohistochemistry: EMA positive; SSTR2A positive; progesterone receptor positive
- CNS WHO grade 1
